external_boundary: Public SearXNG instances can rate-limit or become unavailable. Official provider APIs can change or temporarily fail. Sensitive data must not be submitted to public web services; use a private SearXNG instance for confidential work. V16 does not fabricate patient cohorts, licensed database rights, wet-lab outcomes, independent-site validation, ethics approvals, expert authority or regulatory clearance. A local package check, SHA-256 record, execution preflight, draft manifest or displayed visual state is not a scientific or organizational approval.

installer_contract_fix.issue: Step 193 mandatory self-test used obsolete step193_part markers during Step 196 post-install validation
installer_contract_fix.resolution: Active release marker/helper detection is dynamic; version baseline compatibility is checked against current VERSION; pre-install contract test added

installer_lock_fix.issue: PID/age-based JSON lock could falsely block after crashes or Windows PID reuse.
installer_lock_fix.resolution: OS-owned non-blocking file lock. Windows automatically releases it when the owning process exits; a leftover file is non-blocking.

dependency_order_fix.issue: Pre-install contract imported the scientific module graph before pandas and other wheels were installed.
dependency_order_fix.resolution: New standard-library-only pre-install contract; scientific imports and module qualification run only with .venv Python after offline bootstrap.

online_setup_fix.issue: Ollama and model download ran while the core installer lock was held, causing second-launch already-running messages and long apparent hangs.
online_setup_fix.resolution: Core installation completes and releases its lock first; optional Ollama/model provisioning continues in a separate background worker and cannot fail core installation.

scientific_runtime_setup.issue: The prior specialist-runtime launchers were separate from the required two-step Windows workflow, and installed state was not clearly distinguished from scientific qualification.
scientific_runtime_setup.resolution: INSTALL_WINDOWS.bat starts a non-blocking local readiness worker after verified core setup. It plans the 25 weakest modules, attempts small public reference acquisition, and uses the existing resumable WSL2/micromamba workflow for public engines when Windows, storage and WSL2 are available.
scientific_runtime_setup.never_auto_completed: provider-authorized/licence-controlled tools, very-large reference databases, model/cohort qualification, wet-lab evidence, external confirmation, governance and controlled release

runtime_handover_fix.issue: A shared local runtime record could treat a live older extracted release as a hard launch error for the current release.
runtime_handover_fix.resolution: The launcher verifies each recorded UI, API or worker PID by command line and recorded extraction root, safely hands off confirmed old BioIntel processes, discards stale or reused-PID records without terminating unrelated processes, then launches the current release.

user_flow: Extract all five matching ZIP parts into the same empty folder
